reconstruction_summary: Reproduced agent's V4 (their declared best: 'RMSE dropped from V0 = 0.01613 rad/s to V4 = 0.01035 rad/s'): per-segment grid search over (alpha, k_scale, lag) on bicycle model psi_dot = v/(L + k_scale*K_us*v^2)*tan(alpha*delta_road) with per-segment bias removal; platform L and K_us from agent's parameters.py (Mach-E and F-150 Lightning).
notes: Agent self-scored Mach-E only; canonical extends to F-150 Lightning. Model has no saved coefficients — V4 re-fits per-segment hyperparameters (alpha, k_scale, lag) plus a bias on each segment, so canonical leakage per the YAML note applies fully. Platform-specific (L, K_us) taken from agent's parameters.py: Mach-E K_us=5.62e-4, F-150 K_us=4.53e-4 (both understeer-tending). n_samples is 1363248 vs cached 1364925 because V4 trims |best_lag| samples per segment from the aligned arrays; baseline_rmse_recomputed (over full v>2 mask) matches the cached canonical V0 exactly.
